assessment: This study provides valuable new insights as to how two evolutionary conserved motifs in CD4 contribute to the CD4-mediated enhancement of TCR signaling independently of the CD4-LCK interaction. The data at hand are convincing, even if confined to a cell line model and not substantiated in vivo and with little new mechanistic insight provided regarding the domains of CD4 shown to have significant roles in the signaling process. Without the data from primary cells it is difficult to make statements about the quantitative contribution of LCK-dependent and independent functions of CD4 in TCR signaling.
